message: 隠し味は思いやり

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Synn
message: 「After that yesterday, Lolotte... she was really down, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「She was trying so hard to get you to join us... and when she found out you had the same goal as us, she looked so happy, didn't she」

name: Azel
message: 「I believe I told you not to get involved」

name: Synn
message: 「But--」

name: Azel
message: 「We have nothing to talk about」

name: Synn
message: 「Fine. Just apologize to Lolotte. If you do that, I won't bother you anymore」

name: Azel
message: 「Why would you go that far for Lolotte's sake?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, you see~ Isn't it because he's in love with Lolotte-chan~?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa~ Right on the mark~ This is bad news~」

name: Synn
message: 「You tricked me into confessing!\s01」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Good thing Nana-chan isn't here, huh~」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka has nothing to do with this!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph. How frivolous」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What did you say!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa there, easy~ I don't know what happened, but if you fight, you'll lose all your calcium~」

name: Synn
message: 「I have plenty of calcium!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not quite right, Sacchin-san. It's when you don't have enough calcium that you get irritable easily」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, right, right~ That's how it goes~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「W-Whoa!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san! It's our precious lunch break, so it's such a waste to make a scowling face like that」

name: Azel
message: 「Wh-What are you doing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~~. Azel-san, your cheeks are so soft」

name: Azel
message: 「L-Let go!!」
She's become so energetic it's hard to imagine how down she was yesterday.

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's great, isn't it, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What is」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~」
She's usually so dense, yet when it comes to romance, her intuition is sharp.

name: Synn
message: 「Look, Azel. Lolotte came by to see you again」

name: Azel
message: 「I never asked her to」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Actually, you see, I brought lunch for you~\s07」

name: Azel
message: 「Listen to what I'm saying!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you understand how we feel a little better now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today, it's a three-tiered bento made by Jiiya!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Three tiers of Japanese, Western, and Chinese cuisine, catching a variety of needs」

name: Synn
message: 「How about th~is!!」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't want it」

name: Synn
message: 「With something this delicious-looking right in front of you...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, would you like some?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh...? Y-Yeah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Digging i~n♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. Um, are you okay...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wonder if there was something Azel didn't like~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For example, Mr. President. Is there any food you dislike?」

name: Synn
message: 「Me? Not really」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, that's no help at all~」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right... If I had to say, I guess mochi scares me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Really?! Then we must stop Senpai at once」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm kidding!!」
I can't afford to lose a valuable source of nutrition.

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, um... Sacchin, help me out!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nom, nom. This is yummy~ Totally exquisite~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh?! Me?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm not really a fan of goya champuru~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh-ho~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Bitter melon stir-fry, right? I think the bitterness makes it tasty, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's a grown-up taste~ But I still wanna stay a kid for a while longer~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then conversely, what is a food universally loved by everyone across the world?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「H~~mm」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Curry rice or hamburger steak?」

name: Synn
message: 「That basically just ended up being your favorite foods, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is what you would call the global standard♪」

name: Synn
message: 「But hamburg steak is right there in the Western food row, isn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, it means they are not fond of hamburg steak」

name: Synn
message: 「Then it really is curry rice after all?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That really is what it comes down to, isn't it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you going to do after looking all that up?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why, I am going to make whatever Azel-san wants to eat, of course!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Amaazing. You're good at cooking?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, not at all. In fact, I believe my skill level is roughly the same as yours, Sacchin-san」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I haven't even shown off my cooking, and you're already assuming that\s06 Not that you're wrong, though\s06」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, knowing Azel-san, if it isn't delicious, they will surely complain again and refuse to eat it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so, I came up with an idea!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When you think of curry rice, you think of the President!! If I have you teach me, Mr. President, I am sure I will be able to make a flavor that satisfies Azel-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Me? Wouldn't Riesling-san be a better choice? Seeing as she can make food this good」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu～～」

name: Synn
message: 「Plus, I heard she even knows someone who runs a curry shop」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That will not do!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you getting mad?\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It has to be you, Mr. President!!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right, I get it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're really dense, aren't you, Synn-kun? Munch, munch……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, let us head out shopping right away～」

name: Synn
message: 「We don't need to wait for Riesling-san and Amyrina, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! Today is special training for just the two of us♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ufufu\s04」
Saying 'just the two of us' without a shred of shame--she really is trouble.
Still, losing my nerve would disgrace my status as the older one. Here, I have to take the lead like a man.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, Lolotte」
I hold out my hand with a sharp snap. Just taking a girl by the hand is no big deal at all!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!\s04」
Whoa, she clung right onto my arm!?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, let's go~~♪」
Ah, aah, so soft~~.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, ah...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah--!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President-san! Next is this way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah--!」
Still, considering I used to get dragged around by just one arm and now it's her whole body, that's quite a step up.
I'd be happy if this reflects even a little bit of how close Lolotte and I have gotten.

name: Lolotte
message: 「By the way, President-san, when it comes to curry rice, what kind of curry is your go-to?」

name: Synn
message: 「For me, it's vegetable curry. What about you, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I suppose it would have to be fine beef curry」

name: Synn
message: 「B-Beef!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With plenty of curry roux poured right over a beefsteak sitting atop the rice♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah, what luxury!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Unfortunately, I've only ever had beef-in-name-only curry stewed with tiny scraps of beef tendon」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~~. That also sounds like it would be richly infused with the flavor of the meat」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on, though!! There's no guarantee Azel likes beef」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I recall correctly, some people say cows are messengers from heaven, so eating them is strictly forbidden」

name: Synn
message: 「Messengers from heaven... you mean angels?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Moo, moo. Am I a cow?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't produce any milk, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If I had to say... let's see~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! Mr. President, you have quite a keen eye」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Speaking of angels, it has to be pigs~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「...And so, we ended up making orthodox pork curry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's packed full of vitamin B」
Though it has nothing to do with angels at all.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's start cooking」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah, I told you, you can't!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Weren't we supposed to make it together?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, please just watch over me from behind」
Lolotte rolls up her sleeves and snorts proudly.
She's brimming with motivation.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Chesuto--!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Teirya--!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you put that much force into it, they're gonna go flying」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaaah--」
A potato rolls away across the floor, with Lolotte chasing right after it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just imitating how Jeeves does it isn't working out well...」
How does Riesling usually cook, anyway...?

name: Synn
message: 「Um... I think it's better to peel the potatoes first.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Peel...? Ahh~~. True, we can't eat them like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Normally you'd peel them with a knife, but I think around here...」

name: Synn
message: 「Found it, found it. Here, a peeler.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold the potato firmly, and peel it like this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「O-Oooh~~.」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's try doing the rest of the potatoes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, Coach!」
Coach?

name: Synn
message: 「Once you're done, let's cut them with a knife next.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, Coach!」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, you don't need to hold it like you're about to stab someone\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wouldn't do that!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me Riesling holds it like that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. Grandpa's knife work is so fast I can't even see it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, you don't need to grip it like a dagger. Like this--」
Wrapping my palm around Lolotte's small fist, I slowly demonstrate how to cut.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, your hands... are really big~~.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Having them wrapped around mine feels so warm and nice~~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see\s03」
Lolotte's straightforward words make me strangely self-conscious.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being pressed so close together like this makes my heart race...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry! I didn't mean anything weird by it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「After all, it's much easier for you to teach me this way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you hate it……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hate it, never!! If anything, I want to stay like this even longer」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if we keep clinging to each other like this forever……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What will happen……?」
Lolotte's soft body--wait, no, bad thoughts!

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, alright, back to cooking」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I often hear that onions sting the eyes, but they didn't bother me at all」

name: Synn
message: 「I chilled them in the fridge beforehand, after all. Plus, using a sharp knife helps……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh-ho~~」
Even so, just teaching her a couple of quick tricks brought about a staggering change in Lolotte.
It was hard to believe she was the same girl who had been cleaving vegetables in two just moments ago.
Naturally, she struggled until she got the hang of it, leaving a few bandages scattered on her fingers.
Yet through it all, Lolotte never once lost her smile.

name: Synn
message: 「Allllright. Now that we're done chopping, let's get stir-frying」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you remember how to stir-fry?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You fry the ingredients that take longest to cook first.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the three rules of cooking?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Care, grit, and love!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep, spot on. Let's get started then」

name: Lolotte
message: 「First, the onions!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And then the meat!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Smoke……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ch-Chairman! It's already burning onto the pan!」

name: Synn
message: 「……!? Don't tell me you didn't put any oil in?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!! This is a major crisis!! Oil, oil\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah, if you pour oil in while the burner's still on--」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's your deal, you're so noisy~」
Seriously, why do you always show up at a time like this.

name: Paqy
message: 「Uheee!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-Why……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Waaah!! Mr. Panda!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Water, get water」
While we were panicking, our precious ingredients ended up burnt to a crisp.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Euu…… Even though I managed to cut them so well……」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like we'll have to start over……」
Still, there's no way we bought extras, so we'll have to go shopping all over again.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry, President……」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry, don't worry. It's my fault for not noticing, too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu…… It's so frustrating~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hold on a second!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Thank you for taking care of the young lady」

name: Synn
message: 「Ms. Riesling!!」

name: Riesling
message: 「These are refreshments for you」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, heavy!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-This is……」
A brand-new curry set!! And a whole bunch of it, too.

name: Riesling
message: 「And this as well」
Bandages…….

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you so much」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, please excuse me」

name: Synn
message: 「……Is there anything you'd like me to pass along to Lolotte?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Just remember, never give up.」
For some reason, Riesling was hiding behind the door, showing only a single hand giving a thumbs-up.

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling brought these for us!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya did...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!! With this much, I can mess up as many times as I want!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe, I'm just kidding~. I'll have to thank Jiiya later.」

name: Synn
message: 「So, do you think you can do it... just like before?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, of course!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, I've added the water too... Now we just have to wait a bit.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it all done now!?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it doesn't even look like curry yet. We've finally just reached the halfway point.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauu... The path of cooking is a steep one.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'm impressed you managed to keep fighting against that cold water in this freezing weather~~ Very impressive.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I did end up getting pretty chilled, though... Brrr.」
This might be another chance to hold Lolotte's hand....

name: Lolotte
message: 「President...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, what is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could you go 'haa haa' for me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「On my hands, go 'haa haa'」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What do you mean by th--\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please blow your warm breath on them, like 'haaa, haaa'\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Ohh, that's what you meant~~\s10 Well, why didn't you say so... Haaaah.」
I blow warm breath onto Lolotte's freezing-cold clenched fists.

name: Lolotte
message: 「More, please」

name: Synn
message: 「Haaah, haaah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「More, more」

name: Synn
message: 「Haaaah, haaaah!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Moooore!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah... haaaah... gah, haaaah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe♪ I got so much of your warmth, President\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Haah... haah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your face is all bright red and steaming too, President. It's plain as day~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean killing two birds with one stone...」
What a little devil wearing an angel's mask.
Well, she's happy, so I'll let it slide. Actually, I just should've remembered to take breaths properly.
A short break while it simmers.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, wanna play a 25-pitch home run derby together?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Hmm, I see」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, that book is--」
Lolotte was engrossed in the knitting book borrowed from the library.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President. I've been wondering this for a long time, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is knitting fun?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're making that face right after asking?」
With her eyes sparkling, she looks super eager.

name: Synn
message: 「There's some yarn over here, so why don't you give it a try?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yay~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's your first time...」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A scarf?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Size doesn't matter for this one」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh-ho~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's give it a shot」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-It's tangled around my body... I can't moooove\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「How on earth did you even manage that...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your panties are in full view」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaa, please don't look!\s01」

name: Sally
message: 「Aah, full tummy, full of dreams♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? Lolo-chi, what are you playing~~?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As you can see, it's knitting... N-Nngh, I can't get free...」

name: Sally
message: 「Heeeey~~ That looks kinda pervy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Pretending to teach her just to tie up an angel, expected nothing less from you, Demon Lord」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「From where!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh... Before I knew it, the yarn came untangled」
The doors and windows are locked, so what gap did that shot even come through?!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, let's pull ourselves together and try again!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's make sure you don't get tangled up this time」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Okaaay♪」

name: Sally
message: 「That looks super fun! Teach me too, teach me!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I suppose I can't say no~~」

name: Sally
message: 「U-Ughh... I can't moof...」

name: Synn
message: 「Seriously, how does this keep happening」

name: Paqy
message: 「And it's a turtle-shell bondage tie, no less」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Failure is the Minamoto no Yoritomo of success, after all. Thanks to that, look!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh」
Completely different from before, something like a sash has taken shape.

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. I've started to get the hang of it.」
As expected of someone with nice handwriting, she might just be good with her hands.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though at this size, it'll only work as a scarf for a doll.」

name: Synn
message: 「A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. If you managed this much, all that's left is making it bigger and it'll be finished.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You think so?! Then all I can do is keep practicing from here on out!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then. Should the curry rice be coming along nicely right about now?」

name: Sally
message: 「Curry?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You sure are a glutton, Omake-san. Didn't you just say your stomach was full and your chest was oppai a moment ago?」

name: Sally
message: 「There's always room for curry rice!! Though there was some yummy-looking nikujaga, so I accidentally ate it」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, nice~. Where'd you eat it?」

name: Sally
message: 「The kitchen」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The curry rice is gone!\s08」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehhh--?! That was the curry rice?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, it might've looked like nikujaga, but come on--!! It was just simmering!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. It didn't have any flavor, so I put soy sauce on it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-saaaan!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Waaah--, I didn't mean anything bad by it--. I'll help out, so forgive me~~\s06」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Sally-chan didn't do it on purpose either... Look, we still have the ingredients Riesling-san brought us, too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're right. I'm sure if we make it over and over, we'll get better at it. And if we do, Azel-san is sure to say it's delicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Let's stay positive」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's native thinking~~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, Omake-san. First, we'll start with peeling」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, I love you, Roro-chi!」
And so, they started making it all over again――

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmmm~~. It's starting to smell delicious~~」
Lolotte twitches her nose happily.
After putting this much effort into making it, the joy when it's finished will surely be immeasurable.

name: Synn
message: 「Now we let it simmer slowly over low heat like this」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And then it'll be finished!?」

name: Synn
message: 「No……!! We let it sit overnight like this to deepen the flavor」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehehe, is the curry rice ready yet~~? Zzz……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hehehe. What a little kid」

name: Synn
message: 「Your own eyelids are looking pretty heavy too, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-That's not true at all!! I'm still bursting with legendary energy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmph, mmph」
She hastily rubs her sleepy eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「You must be tired after today~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, honestly…… I never imagined cooking took this much stamina」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, when you don't have the knack for it yet. Once you learn to multitask, though, presto! You'll be able to whip things up in no time」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Though curry rice is a bit of a special case. Can't be helped if we want them to say, 'Delicious!'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's…… true……」

name: Synn
message: 「By tomorrow, it's sure to be reborn as some wonderful curry rice!! Wait, huh……?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz…… zzz……」
Her soft body gently leans its weight against me.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if you remake it three times」
Exhausted myself, I slump down on the spot right alongside Lolotte.
I never knew cooking with someone you love could be this much fun.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President……」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hamburg steak……」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha」
I relax and unwind while chatting with Lolotte's sleep-talking.
This heartwarming atmosphere. Her peaceful, healthy sleeping face that soothes my soul.
When I gently stroke her soft, fair cheek, Lolotte smiles comfortably.

name: Synn
message: 「I can't just leave her here like this…… hup!」
This small body I've held and supported countless times before.
If only I could keep supporting Lolotte like this forever.

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave Milady's peaceful slumber to this Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「You can come in」

name: Riesling
message: 「Excuse me」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte fell asleep, so could I ask you to see her home?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes. For that is the duty of a butler, this Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll take responsibility and bring the curry rice tomorrow」

name: Riesling
message: 「Understood. Thank you very much」
Riesling gives a dignified bow and departs without making a sound.
It's a little disappointing, but I can see Lolotte anytime from now on.
We'll have plenty more time to do things together like this. So there's no need to rush.
And this curry rice we worked so hard to make.
I'm sure Azel will be thrilled with it too.
